create_aws_container_instance: create a single AWS ECS container instance with a container definition and command
create_multiple_aws_container_instances: create multiple AWS ECS container instances in batch with individual commands and env vars
get_aws_container_instance: get the details of a single AWS ECS container instance by its instance ID
cancel_aws_container_instance: cancel and stop a running AWS ECS container instance by its instance ID
get_aws_cluster_info: get the current cluster instance info including running and pending task counts
